identity: Leiden University full-time English-taught BA South and Southeast Asian Studies, BA-ZZO, 2026–2027
confirmed: Thirty compulsory EC plus 5 religion, 20 sequential Hindi, and 5 regional elective EC in the first year. Islam and Classics of Asia are the first-listed eligible examples. The four languages are choices within the BA. OER Article 4.2 records language progression, Seminar II entry after 45 first-year EC including Seminar I, Seminar III after the first year and 45 second-year EC including Seminar II, and thesis entry after both full years. Year three lists a 10 EC thesis, 30 EC open space and 15 EC study abroad or a Leiden alternative; these are verified requirements or catalogue structures, not a certified route through the unresolved second year.
